message:
How it reads now:
Plans sheet
Name (text, required), Start date (date), Manager (person), Buddy (person), IT (person).

Tasks sheet
Plan (one row from Plans, required), Task (text, required), Owner (person), Due (date).

Steps
To do → Doing → Done

Who can see and do what
Priya Nair, Wade Wilson and Aisha Khan see every plan, add, edit and move them, and change how it works.
Managers see their own plans and can add, edit and move them.
Buddies see their own plans and can move them.
Task owners see their own tasks and can move them.
Everyone else sees nothing.

Connections
People fills Manager.
People fills Buddy.
People fills IT.
People fills Owner.

Coming soon
Connections to other software

Latest message from Wade Wilson:
Add an Equipment sheet for each new hire's laptop and accounts. Managers should see their own hires' equipment.
